description: This Java class 'OfbizCatalogAltUrlTransform' implements the FreeMarker TemplateTransformModel to generate URLs for product categories and products within the OFBiz framework. It processes template arguments and request context to produce complete URL strings, supporting options for full path and secure URLs, and handles retrieval of related entities and their wrappers for URL construction.

classes.name: OfbizCatalogAltUrlTransform
classes.description: A FreeMarker template transform to generate URLs for product categories or products within the OFBiz framework, supporting options for full path and secure URLs, and utilizing entity wrappers and request context.

methods.name: getStringArg
methods.description: Retrieves a string argument from a map of template arguments, handling different implicit types such as SimpleScalar, GenericObjectModel, SimpleNumber, and NumberModel.

methods.name: checkArg
methods.description: Checks and interprets a boolean argument from template args, with a default fallback if the key is absent.
